plays.desc_ko: 초반 바텀 2대2에서 IG 서포터(자막 'make', Meiko로 추정)가 패시브를 발동하려 앞으로 나섰다가 첫 교전에서 체력을 크게 잃음. 해설은 Jiaqi 쪽이 예상보다 불리해졌고 TES가 바텀 주도권을 잡았다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: In an early bot 2v2, IG's support (captioned 'make', likely Meiko) steps forward to proc his passive but loses a big chunk of health in the first exchange. The casters note JiaQi's side is worse off than expected and TES has taken bot priority.
plays.quote: losing a lot ... of HP in the initial trade there as he ... tried to step forward and proc the

plays.desc_ko: Wei의 우회(wrap around) 갱킹에 Rookie가 점멸-즉시 기절을 넣고, 제이스 기술(하늘로!/천둥 강타)로 마무리해 퍼스트 블러드를 기록. 이후 해설이 '미드에서 이기고 있다'고 언급해 미드 대상 갱으로 보이나 피해자 이름은 직접 나오지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Wei (Jayce) wraps around for a gank as Rookie (Annie) lands a Flash into instant stun, and Jayce's To the Skies!/Thundering Blow finishes the job for First Blood. The victim isn't named, but the casters' 'winning mid' comment suggests a mid gank.
plays.quote: flash in get the immediate stun to the ... skies fall with the thundering blow to ... finish the kill.

plays.desc_ko: 퍼스트 블러드와 같은 시점에 TES 정글(자막 'TM', Tian으로 추정)이 반대편에서 칼날부리(raptors)를 챙기려 함. IG가 플레이를 이어가려 한다는 언급이 뒤따르나 구체적 행동은 없음.
plays.desc_en: At the same time as First Blood, TES's jungler (captioned 'TM', likely Tian) looks to take raptors on the opposite side, while IG appears set to keep making plays.
plays.quote: TM's going to get the ... raptors,

plays.desc_ko: 탑에서 TheShy(오른)가 많은 피해를 입고 뒤로 밀려남. 상대 탑 라이너 369(럼블)의 라인 압박으로 해석되나 369 이름은 이 구간에 직접 나오지 않음.
plays.desc_en: TheShy (Ornn) takes heavy damage in top and is pushed back, likely from 369 (Rumble)'s lane pressure, though 369 isn't named directly here.
plays.quote: the Shai taking a ... lot of damage here. ... Shai getting forced backwards as another

plays.desc_ko: 미드에서 또 한 번의 기절이 강화된 전격 폭발(제이스)로 이어지며 Cream이 일방적으로 괴롭힘을 당함. 신발 선택 덕에 Q3 위험 없이 평타를 섞을 수 있다는 부연.
plays.desc_en: Another stun in mid leads into an empowered Shock Blast from Jayce as Creme (Yone) gets bullied. The casters add that his boots choice lets him weave in autos without fear of Q3.
plays.quote: stun leads to that empowered shock blast ... and Cream getting bullied.

plays.desc_ko: Tian이 미드로 합류하고 369도 넘어오며 미드/강가 교전을 시도. 궁극기가 교환됐지만 Cream이 이미 크게 체력을 잃었고 Rookie의 판단으로 TES의 반격이 막힘.
plays.desc_en: Tian (Skarner) joins mid and 369 crosses over for a mid/river skirmish. Ultimates are traded, but Creme is already badly hurt and Rookie's decision-making shuts down TES's counterattack.
plays.quote: As Tienne ... also wants to visit mid lane. ... 369 trying to move over though.

plays.desc_ko: TheShy가 369를 노리고 궁극기를 맞힘. Wei가 369에게 크게 녹지만 369의 과열로 IG가 접근을 꺼림. Tian은 블루 버프를 지키려 1대1, TheShy의 돌진은 에어본을 못 맞힘. 꿀열매 활용 등으로 강가 소모전은 IG 승리, Rookie는 Cream과의 1대1을 버팀.
plays.desc_en: TheShy (Ornn) lands his ultimate on 369, and Wei takes heavy damage from 369, but Rumble's overheat makes IG hesitant to approach. Tian duels to protect his blue buff while TheShy's charge misses its knock-up; using honeyfruit, IG wins the river attrition and Rookie holds his 1v1 against Creme.
plays.quote: The Shai now looking to ... set up onto 369. Alti manages connect. ... Weey getting burned down.

plays.desc_ko: 소모전 승리 후 IG가 결국 바위게를 확보.
plays.desc_en: After winning the attrition fight, IG finally secures the Scuttle Crab.
plays.quote: The Shai handles his with 369 and ... they do in the end get the objective of ... crab.

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 2대2에서 점멸·정화가 교환되고, 6레벨 이후 Jiaqi가 E 대시와 평타로 JackeyLove를 끝내려 벽 넘어까지 추격. 그러나 다시보기 해설에 따르면 JackeyLove는 둔화를 맞고도 걸어서 빠져나갔고 Zeri의 전기 공격은 맞지 않음. 해설은 Jiaqi의 '탐욕'으로 평가.
plays.desc_en: Flashes and Cleanse are traded in the bot 2v2, and after level 6 JiaQi (Zeri) chases JackeyLove (Ashe) over the wall with Spark Surge and autos. The replay shows JackeyLove walking out despite the slow as Zeri's Burst Fire missed, which the casters called greed.
plays.quote: It's Jackie Leo who are handling the 2v2 ... HAVE enough left on the E dash forward ... pulled through auto attacks to finish

plays.desc_ko: Jiaqi가 점멸·정화 없이 JackeyLove의 화살에 맞고, Meiko 궁극기에도 TES의 분산 콜(반대 방향)로 IG 주의가 갈림. Tian(스카너)이 합류해 밀쳐내고 Jiaqi를 처치, 고양이(유미)까지 잡음. 다시보기는 궁극기가 반대로 간 덕에 Tian이 쉽게 들어왔다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: Without Flash or Cleanse, JiaQi (Zeri) is hit by JackeyLove's arrow, and TES's split call pulls IG's attention away from Meiko's ultimate. Tian (Skarner) arrives to displace and kill JiaQi, then the cat (Yuumi) too; the replay shows the ult going the wrong way let Tian walk in easily.
plays.quote: NO CLENCH FOR THE ... ARROW. ULTI COMING FROM MAKO. ... AND HERE COMES THE SCARNNER.

plays.desc_ko: IG가 부시에 숨어 Rookie가 귀환한 척 속인 뒤 바텀/드래곤 근처에서 교전. Zeri 궁극기가 다시 들어오지만 정화 없이 물러나야 했고 JackeyLove가 반격 사격. 전기 레이저는 빗나가지만 Wei의 전격 폭발이 이어지며 '다시 시도'해 한 명을 되갚아 잡음. Wei는 생존. 해설은 정글러들이 바텀에 몰려 있다고 언급.
plays.desc_en: IG hides in a bush with Rookie faking a recall, then fights near bot and dragon. JiaQi's Lightning Crash comes in but she must retreat without Cleanse as JackeyLove fires back; the laser misses, yet Wei's Shock Blast follows to trade back a kill while Wei survives, with both junglers clustered bot.
plays.quote: Accelerating shot blast potential here ... as IG were hovered in the bush. ... basically faking that rookie had reset.

plays.desc_ko: Tian이 드래곤을 치기 시작하자 IG가 드래곤 둥지 뒤 와드로 이를 보고 견제. 369가 TheShy의 점멸을 빼낸 뒤 TES가 여파 속에서 드래곤을 되찾아 Tian이 획득.
plays.desc_en: IG spots Tian starting dragon through a ward behind the pit and contests. After 369 (Rumble) forces out TheShy's Flash, TES retakes control in the aftermath and Tian secures the dragon.
plays.quote: but luckily Ten's starting to drake, so ... as 369 does get the flash out of the ... Shai, but okay. So, they did recover the

plays.desc_ko: IG가 와드로 Tian의 드래곤 시도를 확인하고 Rookie가 들어와 쫓아내려(견제) 함. 그러나 TES가 결국 드래곤을 확보.
plays.desc_en: IG sees Tian's dragon attempt through a ward and Rookie (Annie) moves in to zone him off, but TES still secures the dragon.
plays.quote: and they saw him go in here so they know ... they can contest. ... and so Rookie has arrived to try and

plays.desc_ko: Wei가 바텀에 대기하는 가운데 Rookie가 귀환 후 바텀으로 순간이동. Zeri 궁극기 진입, 정화가 이미 빠진 JackeyLove를 한 방에 잡고 다른 한 명도 위기, Rookie가 추가 킬. TheShy는 미드를 커버하고, 이후 Rookie는 남아 웨이브를 밀어냄. 해설: IG가 JackeyLove를 게임에서 지우려 집중.
plays.desc_en: With Wei waiting bot, Rookie (Annie) recalls and Teleports in. Zeri's Lightning Crash dives in to one-shot a Cleanse-less JackeyLove, another TES player is endangered and Rookie adds a kill, while TheShy covers mid and Rookie stays to push the wave as IG focuses on taking JackeyLove out of the game.
plays.quote: Way still hovering in the bottom ... as there's a TP to the bottom side as ... crash coming in. CLEANS ALREADY. BURNED.

plays.desc_ko: 바텀 교전 동안 TES가 크로스맵으로 만회를 시도해 369가 탑 포탑 방패(플레이트)를 하나 더 챙김. 해설은 '그게 전부'라고 평가.
plays.desc_en: During the bot fight, TES tries to trade cross-map as 369 (Rumble) takes one more top turret plate, which the casters say was all they got.
plays.quote: TES they're trying to get a little bit ... back in the cross map. At least they ... will have 369 get a another plate here,

plays.desc_ko: 교전 후 IG가 귀환하고 바텀 듀오가 겁 없이 앞으로 나서며 미드를 열어감.
plays.desc_en: After the fight, IG resets and their bot duo steps up fearlessly to open up mid.
plays.quote: IG though resetting, opening up ... mid with their bottom lane as not afraid ... to step forward.

plays.desc_ko: TES가 다른 지점을 찾아 탑에서 TheShy를 공략. TheShy는 저지 불가로 Tian의 궁극기(꿰뚫기)를 무력화하고 버티며 오른 궁극기(뿔)를 불지만, 결국 탑에서 서서히 불타 사망. 해설: 한 번 살았는데 다시 들어갔다가 잡힘.
plays.desc_en: TES looks elsewhere and targets TheShy (Ornn) top. TheShy uses unstoppable to negate Tian's Impale and calls Call of the Forge God, but slowly burns down in top after surviving once and going back in.
plays.quote: the shai unstoppable. Impale not ... hold the line here as TES try to find a ... Horn horn has been blown. The ram is on

plays.desc_ko: JackeyLove가 포탑에서 밀려나고 Wei가 측면에서 대기. 궁극기가 즉시 Tian에게 들어가 교전 전에 체력을 다 잃고, 유미 Q·Zeri 레이저·Zeri 궁극기가 이어져 Tian 처치.
plays.desc_en: JackeyLove is pushed off the tower as Wei waits on the flank. An ultimate hits Tian immediately and drains his health before the fight, and Yuumi's Q, Zeri's laser, and Lightning Crash follow to kill Tian.
plays.quote: Jacko forced off the tower now way is ... waiting off the side as power shock ... have finished the job. Ali instantly

plays.desc_ko: Tian 처치 후 IG가 미드 포탑을 철거. Meiko가 포탑 공격을 받아내 Jiaqi가 자유롭게 들어감.

plays.quote: Mid lane ... tower now going to fall. ... Mako even tanking the turret so Jachi

plays.desc_ko: 화살이 적중하고 369의 이퀄라이저로 점멸을 빼낸 뒤, 369가 바텀으로 로밍해 점멸 플레이로 IG의 주 캐리 Jiaqi를 처치. 해설은 직전 Jiaqi가 킬을 올렸고 이를 되갚은 것이라 언급.
plays.desc_en: An arrow lands and 369 (Rumble)'s The Equalizer burns a Flash, then 369 roams bot and makes a Flash play to kill IG's main carry JiaQi, avenging her earlier kill.
plays.quote: The arrow is going to ... connect. Equalizer could as well forcing ... KILL TRADED

plays.desc_ko: Zeri가 빠진 틈에 TES가 적극적 세팅으로 협곡의 전령을 시도. 그러나 IG가 개입해 전령을 가져감.
plays.desc_en: With Zeri down, TES sets up aggressively for Rift Herald, but IG steps in and takes it.
plays.quote: the Zary off the table though, Top ... Eport's going to go for Rift Herald. ... Definitely have a proactive setup.

plays.desc_ko: Rookie가 티버를 준비한 채 진입, Wei의 전격 폭발이 Cream을 크게 깎고, TheShy가 순간이동으로 합류(언제든 뿔로 재진입 가능). IG가 전령을 쉽게 가져감.
plays.desc_en: Rookie enters with Tibbers ready, Wei's Shock Blast chunks Creme, and TheShy Teleports in with Call of the Forge God available for re-engage. IG takes Herald easily.
plays.quote: Rookie on the way in. ... a nice shock blast chunk out cream TP on ... the way in from the shai.

plays.desc_ko: IG가 전령을 포탑 쪽으로 돌진시키고(Meiko 탑승 추정), 도망치는 Tian에게 오른 궁극기가 들어가 서서히 녹임. 원형질 방패로 1초 버티지만 IG가 킬 추가. 해설은 전령이 플레이에 쓰여 포탑은 못 깼다고 지적.
plays.desc_en: IG charges Herald toward a tower (likely ridden by Meiko), and TheShy's ultimate catches the fleeing Tian. He survives a second with a shield but IG adds the kill; the casters note Herald was spent on the play rather than the turret.
plays.quote: that tower. Herold's going to charge in. ... Mo picking it up. Tien now running out. ... That's the alti.

plays.desc_ko: 그 사이 369가 스플릿 푸시로 바텀 포탑을 파괴.
plays.desc_en: Meanwhile, 369 (Rumble) split pushes and destroys the bot tower.
plays.quote: meantime is split pushing. ... got a turret in that bottom lane as

plays.desc_ko: TES가 미드를 장악하며 Jiaqi가 홀로 있음을 포착, 강가 시야를 잡고 대기. 잘못 들어온 Jiaqi를 점멸·정화 없는 상태에서 CC로 잡아 처치하고, 시작에 Meiko도 잡고 한 명 더 녹임. 해설: TheShy가 없으면 IG가 시야 확인(페이스체크)하기 어렵다는 점을 이용.
plays.desc_en: TES controls mid, spots a lone JiaQi, and waits with river vision. They CC and kill her with no Flash or Cleanse, catch Meiko at the start, and melt another, exploiting IG's lack of face-check without TheShy.
plays.quote: TES trying to take control of ... the mid lane recognizes that Jachi is ... TES eyeing him up, recognizing he picked

plays.desc_ko: IG가 미드 웨이브 주도권을 먼저 잡고 시야를 깔아 함정을 준비. '투 포 원'으로 Jace(Wei)를 드래곤에 남기고 나머지는 2차 포탑을 노려 드래곤 획득. 이후 교전 해설에서 오브젝트는 이미 IG가 가져갔다고 재확인.
plays.desc_en: IG takes mid priority and sets a vision trap, leaving Wei (Jayce) on dragon in a four-for-one while the rest pressure the tier-2 tower, securing the dragon as later confirmed.
plays.quote: they're actually getting midwave control ... Setting up vision, looking to lay a ... for the two for one. They leave Jace on

plays.desc_ko: IG의 함정을 읽은 TES가 탑 쪽으로 이동해 Cream이 TheShy를 압박(1대1에서 TheShy가 막기 어렵다는 해설). 영혼 해방(E)이 끝나며 플레이가 이어지지 못하고, TheShy가 탑에서 버팀. 드래곤과 플레이트 교환 가능성은 추측으로만 언급.
plays.desc_en: Reading IG's trap, TES moves top as Creme (Yone) pressures TheShy, said to be hard to stop 1v1. Soul Unbound ends before the play continues and TheShy holds; a dragon-for-plates trade is only speculated.
plays.quote: recognizes. They move into the top side. ... More pressure coming in for Cream. Knows ... this play going, but Solen Bound fades

plays.desc_ko: 드래곤과 동시에 IG가 미드 2차 포탑 공성을 시도. Rookie가 측면 대기, Jiaqi가 369와 붙으려다 체력 60%를 잃음. 바텀 외곽 포탑 대신 미드 포탑 공성 선택.
plays.desc_en: Alongside dragon, IG sieges the mid tier-2 tower instead of the bot outer. Rookie waits on the flank while JiaQi loses 60% health trying to engage 369.
plays.quote: on the tier 2 tower instead. Rookie ... still waiting on the flank. Jachi ready ... to go all in against 369, but needs to

plays.desc_ko: 이퀄라이저가 돌아오자 Tian이 진입 시도, 화살은 빗나가지만 이퀄라이저가 크게 들어가고 유미를 노린 후속기와 세라핀 앙코르까지 연결. 그러나 Zeri 궁극기로 버틴 Jiaqi를 끝내지 못함. 다시보기: Jiaqi는 정화로 빠져나갔고 Rookie도 점멸로 회피, 앙코르가 맞았다면 끝났을 상황.
plays.desc_en: With The Equalizer back, Tian engages; the arrow misses but The Equalizer lands big, followed by skills on Yuumi and Zhuo (Seraphine)'s Encore. JiaQi survives with Lightning Crash, Cleansing out, and Rookie Flashes away, though Encore would have ended it.
plays.quote: Equalizer just came back up. TM looking ... to come in. Arrow going wide. Equalizer ... there. Final temper coming in for THE

plays.desc_ko: 살아남은 Jiaqi가 TES '시체들' 위를 누비며 반격, Wei가 쿨다운을 기다리며 처형 대기, 전격 폭발 한 방이면 JackeyLove도 위험. TheShy가 순간이동으로 합류했지만 오른 궁극기(뿔)는 Cream의 에어본에 끊김.
plays.desc_en: The surviving JiaQi weaves over TES's 'corpses' to counterattack while Wei waits for cooldowns to execute and threatens JackeyLove with one Shock Blast. TheShy Teleports in, but Creme's knock-up interrupts Call of the Forge God.
plays.quote: NOW HE GETS TO SLIDE AND GLIDE AND DANCE ... ALL OVER THE CORPSES OF TEES ... NEED TO GET THE HELL OUT. WEEY WAITING

plays.desc_ko: Cream이 재진입으로 적을 잡고, 돌진 복귀(E)가 끝나기 전 Wei가 기다리는 상황에서 더블킬, 이어 Wei의 처형을 피하려 점멸로 한 명 더. TheShy의 뿔을 에어본으로 끊고 리셋 후 점멸 Q3로 Rookie를 잡음. 교전은 킬 2대2로 마무리.
plays.desc_en: Creme (Yone) re-enters for a double kill before Fate Sealed ends, then Flashes to dodge Wei's execute and take another. He knocks up TheShy's ultimate and, after a reset, Flash Q3s Rookie; the fight ends 2-for-2 in kills.
plays.quote: AS CREAM ... FINDS A RE-ENGAGE TO TAKE HIM DOWN. THE ... DOUBLE

plays.desc_ko: Wei가 진입하고 Cream이 빠져나가려 하지만 갈 곳이 없음. Wei의 피해로 사이드 라인에서 처치. 해설은 이 킬/사이드 픽이 바론으로 이어질 것이라 언급.
plays.desc_en: Wei dives and Creme tries to escape with nowhere to go, dying to Wei's damage in a side lane. The casters say this pick leads into Baron.
plays.quote: way on the way in. Cream might be on the ... way out. There's nowhere for him to go. ... Way's damage is simply disgusting.

plays.desc_ko: 바론 각에서 Rookie가 측면에서 와드를 제거. TES는 둥지 시야가 없어 양보 분위기, Tian이 강타 50/50을 노리며 맴돌다 정글 밖으로 나와 Annie 기절에 걸리고 Jiaqi가 처치.
plays.desc_en: Rookie clears wards from the flank and TES, lacking pit vision, seems to concede. Tian lurks for a 50/50 Smite but steps out, gets caught by Annie's stun, and JiaQi kills him.
plays.quote: Rookie on the flank. ... He's going to kill the wards though. ... TM trying to dance on him.

plays.desc_ko: Tian 처치 후 IG가 바론을 획득한 것으로 보임. 직접적 획득 서술은 마스킹 구간(S0853-S0857)에 걸려 있고, 약 2분 뒤 'his team is still empowered by the Baron' 언급으로 사후 확인.
plays.desc_en: After killing Tian, IG appears to take Baron; the direct call is masked (S0853-S0857), but it's confirmed about two minutes later when the casters note the team is still Baron-empowered.
plays.quote: recipe for a Baron here and the Shai ... Likely they just have to ... kill is down and his team is still

plays.desc_ko: 마스킹 직후 구간에서 누군가가 너무 빨리 죽어 (스킬이) 연결조차 못 됨. Jiaqi가 킬이 났고 팀이 여전히 바론 버프 상태임을 인지하고 자신감 있게 전진.
